title: Munich Motor Imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing two-class motor imagery (left vs. right hand) cued by arrows. Data were recorded with a 128-channel BrainAmp system at 500 Hz, with 150 trials per participant in a single session. The dataset was collected to evaluate beamforming and spatial filtering approaches (e.g., CSP, Laplacian) for noninvasive brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: 128-channel EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp amplifier at 500 Hz, referenced to Cz, with impedances below 10 kOhm. Participants performed haptic motor imagery of the left or right hand for 7 s in response to an arrow cue in a shielded room, without feedback. Data were re-referenced offline to the common average, and no trials were rejected.
